description: Canonical mapping from Writer Storage Policy to VSN-1 Wire Mode. This is a Library-level configuration table, NOT on the wire.

policies.name: HIGHLY_VERTICAL
policies.description: Maximum storage-effort optimization within MODERN wire mode.
constraints: Must not claim global storage optimality
EXTENTS-1 subject to GR-43 bounds (ENTERPRISE forbidden)

policies.name: VERTICAL
policies.description: Bounded storage-effort optimization within MODERN wire mode.
constraints: Fallback to DIRECT-1 if no savings found

policies.name: HORIZONTAL
policies.description: Low storage-effort optimization within ENTERPRISE wire mode.
constraints: EXTENTS-1 not forbidden at wire level but discouraged for normal writes

policies.name: HIGHLY_HORIZONTAL
policies.description: Minimal optimization effort within ENTERPRISE wire mode.
constraints: DIRECT-1 required for ALL emitted content objects
